messages:
Anna (Docs): Draft of the changelog + whatsnew copy for the 0.9.4 rollout is up in PR #5123 — can folks do a quick QA on known issues and the embed examples? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123
Priya (Docs): Scanning now. I spotted the embed streaming section — the python snippet indent is off, and one example uses the old SDK call.
Mike (Product): Heads-up: we should call out the routing fallback behaviour in the notes. Customers need a short caveat, not a full explanation.
Ethan (Eng): I can add a minimal fallback example + updated CLI snippet. Will push a tiny patch to the PR.
Anna (Docs): Please keep commits tiny (one change per commit) so I can review diffs easily. Also the link-checker flagged two redirects as broken in the PR preview.
docs-bot: Linkcheck result: 2 broken links found in PR #5123 — /docs/legacy/redirect -> 404, /sdk/python#examples -> 301. See CI output: https://ci.redwood/links/5123
Priya (Docs): I'll run local linkcheck and open a follow-up PR to fix redirects/anchors. ETA ~30m.
Anna (Docs): Great. Also, do not move large section headings in this PR — just append a 'Known issues' callout. And update SDK snippets to use the new `client.generate(...)` pattern.
Ethan (Eng): Snippet I'll push:
```python
# before
resp = client.completions.create(prompt='hi')

# after
resp = client.generate(prompt='hi')
```
Ethan (Eng): Pushed as a small commit.
Mike (Product): Also add a short bullet: Dedicated customers may see a small perf regression with quantized variants when fallbacks engage. Link to ENG-2345. Keep it non-alarming.
Anna (Docs): Add the bullet under 'Known issues' with link to internal ticket: https://internal.redwood/ENG-2345 — phrase it as a tracked issue.
Priya (Docs): Opened PR #5124 to fix link rot and the snippet indent. @Anna could you quick-review once it's up?
Anna (Docs): On it. If approved I'll merge both and schedule the docs publish. If not by EOD local time I'll merge tomorrow morning.
Ethan (Eng): Merged the snippet fix into #5123. Ran `npm run build` locally — preview looks fine.
docs-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood-docs/pr-5123 — build succeeded ✅
Anna (Docs): @Mike can you confirm the changelog phrasing for the fallback/regression callouts? I want wording that doesn't imply SLA changes.
Mike (Product): Wording suggestion: 'Some customers may observe a transient latency increase when route-fallbacks engage for quantized variants. We are investigating and tracking this under ENG-2345.'
Anna (Docs): That reads well. I'll incorporate and merge after Priya's link PR lands. Thanks everyone :tada:
